register.labelZh: THE GET OUT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: THE GET OUT Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get out 可以表示消息、秘密或某件事的風聲已經傳開。；get out of something 可以描述某人試圖不出席活動、不完成工作或不履行承諾。；這個系列可以描述某人擺脫麻煩,或協助另一個人脫離危險。；談論離開汽車、的士、升降機、房間和其他日常地方時,可以使用 get out 和 get out of。
register.summaryEn: Get out lets you say that news, a secret or word about something has become known. Get out of something can describe trying not to attend an event, complete a task or keep a promise. You can use the family to describe escaping trouble or helping another person reach safety. Get out and get out of are useful when talking about cars, taxis, lifts, rooms and other everyday places.
